cardBlurb: Hexapod leg design with the Electronics and Robotics Club.
cat: Extracurricular: Electronics and Robotics Club, BITS Goa
title: SpiderBot
body: This was a short side project with the Electronics and Robotics Club to build a hexapod robot. My part was mainly the early mechanical design, laser cutting the acrylic body frame and working out a truss pattern for the legs in MATLAB to keep them light without losing strength.

The legs were 3D printed in PLA and driven by individually controlled servos, which let the team later implement tripod and ripple gaits once the mechanical side was in place. I moved on before the later gait tuning work, so I cannot take credit for that part, but the leg geometry and frame were mine.
